assertions.rationale: Attack tree/CPT propagation is fixed Boolean logic using imported EPSS priors. No learned health-world transition; pretrained EPSS likelihoods do not create one.
Evaluated BN is static compromise-event inference; automated dynamic data/model refresh is future work. SysML state diagrams are formal source artefacts, not evaluated learned-time forecasts.
Attack steps and system compromise states retain CVE, architectural component and CIA semantics.
Boolean-gate BN yields formal prior/posterior event probabilities under independent BAS assumptions. This establishes uncertainty representation, not calibrated deployment risk.
STRIDE and CIA architecture-specific CVE attack paths explicitly represented; scoped to agriculture IoT, not clinical WM attacks.
Formal risk/importance calculation ranks vulnerability mitigation priorities; not executed policy or clinical planner.

assertions.applicability_reason: No clinical treatment-effect target: conditional compromise diagnosis in nonmedical formal architecture.
No clinical causal estimand; posterior risk attribution and forced-node Birnbaum sensitivity do not identify real-world clinical interventions.

assertions.rationale: Evidence-conditioned BN updating discussed; no actual live sequential operational assimilation experiment.

legacy_cells.FX: PDF pp. 1–20: title/abstract, introduction, background, methods, smart-agriculture case study, results and relevant Tables 1–6, discussion, conclusion, and stated limitations/future work. References on pp. 21–23 were not reviewed. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The paper's evaluated case study is cybersecurity risk assessment for a smart-irrigation IoT system, not healthcare. General background mentions of healthcare do not change the study domain. Capability Z is not applicable because the paper is neither a healthcare world model nor a relevant healthcare WM component. Table extraction/layout is imperfect in places but does not affect the scope decision. A:I left unchanged. Evidence QA: 1/3 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (33.3%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 2 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Non-healthcare smart irrigation case; no healthcare WM capability label.
Formal attack/BN consistency is not empirical predictive validation.
Imported EPSS priors do not establish local system compromise probabilities or causal identification.
Independent repeated CVE instances are assumed, not validated; shared attack dependencies omitted.
EPSS snapshot/date/horizon duration not pinned; raw tables preserved with unresolved scope.
p15 says BAS1–BAS16, but Figure8 and Tables4/5 contain15 BAS; source inconsistency retained.
No actual cyberattack injection, heldout breach evaluation, patient data, prospective study or clinical benefit.
